invariant: A symbol-container command contributes class-factory evidence only while the complete source remains consumable by that factory. Strong expanded ArchiMate commands and component-only bracket-interface declarations still select their own factories; a shared container keyword cannot override an incompatible child command. Once CLASS is selected, an explicit Folder USymbol uses its folder geometry but retains the established merged folder/package group stroke channel; geometry identity and default stroke thickness are independent properties.
causal_divergence: The full-symbol implementation correctly widened the command table and concrete shapes, but its dispatch ratchet treated the presence of any valid symbol opener as proof that the entire source was class-consumable. It therefore stole an ArchiMate rectangle group and a component container with bracket-interface child. Separately, the generalized uses_symbol_cluster_style predicate assigned every new and existing concrete symbol the one-pixel default, regressing Folder's Java-equivalent 1.5-pixel cluster stroke. These are command-factory and style-ownership regressions, not defects in the new symbol geometries.
planned_change: Keep the shared complete symbol table, but do not apply the class-factory precedence ratchet when explicit expanded ArchiMate evidence is present or when component interface evidence is present without a native non-interface class declaration. Preserve class precedence for symbol containers with actual class children and for otherwise ambiguous empty symbol containers. Restore Folder to the package-group default stroke class while retaining its Folder background/border/font skinparam prefixes and concrete folder geometry. Use the three existing fresh regression tests as executable guards and rerun the complete parser and renderer suites.
perturbation_axes: rectangle symbol container with expanded ArchiMate elements and relations
component symbol container with bracket-interface versus native class children
folder symbol cluster with explicit Folder and Package paint channels
empty symbol containers versus containers with family-exclusive children
new symbol keywords with aliases, stereotypes, and nested classes
scope_boundary: This correction owns subtype precedence for cross-factory symbol keywords and Folder's cluster stroke ownership. It does not narrow the Java CommandPackageWithUSymbol keyword set, remove concrete symbol geometry, or alter package identity and stereotype parsing.
